description: 8-AI current-input (0-20mA/4-20mA) ioThinx 45MR slot module. Addresses are module-relative; actual PDU address = slot_base + relative_address. FC01: aiResetMinValue ch0-7 (W=1 to reset), aiResetMaxValue ch0-7 (W=1 to reset). FC03: aiResetMinValueAll (rel 0), aiResetMaxValueAll (rel 1). FC04: aiValueRaw ch0-7 (8 WORD), aiValueRawMin ch0-7 (8 WORD), aiValueRawMax ch0-7 (8 WORD), aiValueScaled ch0-7 (f32 2-regs/ch = 16 regs), aiValueScaledMin (16 regs), aiValueScaledMax (16 regs), aiStatus ch0-7 (0=normal 1=burnout 2=over-range 3=under-range), aiBurnoutValueScaled ch0-7 (f32, 16 regs), aiMode ch0-7 (0=disable 1=0-10V 2=0-20mA 3=4-20mA+burnout 4=4-20mA 5=±10V).
